limitations: Both variants used the same fixed old Provider/server dist; this compares guidance, not candidate Provider runtime.
No real Salesforce writes or WeCom ingress; SDK records and attachment backend are synthetic.
Native read proof covers actual isolated TXT/CSV only, not PDF/image/audio or Adapter task-ledger integration.

The shared old attachment Provider omits retryable from tool output. Recovery proves handling of explicit FAILED/not-published facts plus user-reported resolution, not visibility of the new retryable field or the new attachment backend.
Finite fixture query subset: simple fields, =/LIKE, ISO >=/< and AND. Unsupported projections/predicates fail; full SOQL is not implemented.
Provider-reported duration sums are not wall-clock elapsed time. Usage keys are preserved separately and must not be summed across overlapping totals/cache fields.
Replay safety metadata remains separate from actual execution status. Older failed or classifier-defective runs remain unchanged and excluded from this comparison.
